narrative: 二元性被做成了几何图形：英雄与说谎者，警察与罪犯，同一个人被切成两半。观众看到一只眼睛在光中，另一只几乎陷入虚无。
音乐、犯罪和道德争论题材使用它，因为这种切割是字面意义上的。对于魅力、浪漫，或任何需要两侧脸颊都在场的段落来说，它就不是合适的工具。
如果你偷偷让补光越过中线，分割光就会瓦解成带包裹感的侧光（Side Lighting）。如果你抬高主光并把它拉向前方，可能会不小心做成伦勃朗光（Rembrandt）。
how: 把一个相对硬朗的主光放在与脸成90度角、大约眼睛高度的位置，让阴影边缘沿着额头、鼻子和下巴向下延伸。补光接近于零。
颜色可以是硬朗的白光，也可以是舞台式色纸；重点在于这道切割，而不是漂亮与否。真正的分割光比一般的侧光更严格，如果需要，会用旗板消灭鼻子上方的包裹光。
提示词：Split lighting on [Subject], one half of the face in light, the other in shadow, a vertical moral cut.
when: 当一个角色同时是两种身份时使用：侧光下的鼓手，侧影思考中的教父。除非你想要威胁感，否则不要在初次约会的特写中使用它。
vs: 侧光是更宽泛的90度方向，依然可以包裹身体或房间。分割光是带有硬朗中线的脸部光型。
伦勃朗光在暗侧脸颊上保留一个三角光斑；分割光没有。环形光（Loop Lighting）要正面得多。
如果暗色脸颊朝向摄影机，窄面光（Short Lighting）可以包含分割光，但窄面光关乎摄影机看到哪一侧脸颊，而不是90度的切割本身。蝴蝶光正好相反：两侧脸颊都开放。
examples_film: 《教父》（The Godfather）在办公室里用半明半暗的脸，让思绪读作一道切割。《爆裂鼓手》（Whiplash）用硬朗的侧向追光，常常在舞台上把脸一分为二。
这种光型是那条中线，而不是一个情绪化的词。
mistakes: 最常见的误用，是伦勃朗光或带包裹感的侧光。破绽是暗色脸颊上出现一个光斑，或者鼻子上方有一道柔和的包裹光。
解决办法是把主光移到90度，并关掉补光，直到中线变得干净。

faq.q: 电影中的分割光是什么？
faq.a: 一个大约90度的主光，照亮脸的一半，让另一半陷入阴影。这道切割沿脸部中线垂直延伸。

faq.q: 分割光和伦勃朗光有什么区别？
faq.a: 分割光在暗侧脸颊上没有三角光斑；那一半完全消失。伦勃朗光在阴影一侧的眼睛下方保留一个小小的光三角形。
用于二元性、审讯，或舞台式的侧向追光。当双眼和两侧脸颊都必须撑起一句台词时，就不要用它。

faq.q: AI 图像或视频中如何提示分割光？
faq.a: 把主光放在90度位置。指明脸的一半在光中，另一半在阴影里，没有补光，也没有伦勃朗式的三角光斑。

narrative: Duality made as geometry: hero and liar, cop and crook, the same person cut in two. The audience gets one eye in light and one in almost nothing.
Music, crime, and moral argument use it because the cut is literal. It is the wrong tool for charm, romance, or any beat that needs both cheeks.
If you sneak fill across the center line, the split collapses into side lighting with wrap. If you raise the key and pull it forward, you may accidentally make Rembrandt.
how: Put a relatively hard key at 90 degrees to the face, at about eye height, so the shadow edge runs down forehead, nose, and chin. Fill is near zero.
Color can be a hard white or a theatrical gel; the point is the cut, not prettiness. A true split is more severe than generic side light because the wrap over the nose is killed with flags if needed.
Prompt: Split lighting on [Subject], one half of the face in light, the other in shadow, a vertical moral cut.
when: Use it when a character is two things at once, a drummer under a side spot, a don in profile thought. Do not use it on a first-date close-up unless you want threat.
vs: Side lighting is the broader 90-degree direction and can still wrap a body or a room. Split is the facial pattern with a hard center line.
Rembrandt lighting keeps a triangle on the dark cheek; split does not. Loop lighting is much more frontal.
Short lighting can include a split if the dark cheek faces camera, but short is about which cheek the camera sees, not the 90-degree cut. Butterfly is the opposite: both cheeks open.
examples_film: The Godfather uses half-lit faces in the office so thought reads as a cut. Whiplash slashes players with hard side spots that often split the face on stage.
The pattern is the center line, not a mood word.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Rembrandt or wrapped side lighting. The tell is a pocket of light on the dark cheek, or a soft wrap over the nose.
Fix it by moving the key to 90 degrees and killing fill until the center line is clean.

faq.q: What is split lighting in film?
faq.a: A key at about 90 degrees that lights one half of the face and leaves the other in shadow. The cut runs vertically down the center of the face.
Split has no triangle on the dark cheek; that half is gone. Rembrandt keeps a small triangle of light under the shadow-side eye.

faq.q: When should I use split lighting?
faq.a: Use it for duality, interrogation, or a theatrical side spot. Skip it when both eyes and both cheeks must sell a line.

faq.q: How do I prompt split lighting for AI image or video?
faq.a: Place the key at 90 degrees. State one half of the face in light, the other in shadow, no fill, no Rembrandt triangle.
